title: Battle of Moys
summary:
The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Moys", at revision 1370450684, opens: "The Battle of Moys was fought on 7 September 1757 during the Third Silesian War. 
A Prussian Army of 13,000 men fought an Austrian army of double their size. The Prussians were defeated and their commander killed." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q663524, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1757 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
